⚡ Quick Installation

The easiest way to install TiLoKit on macOS and Linux. This one-command installation automatically detects your platform and installs the appropriate binary:

curl -fsSL https://tienld-0801.github.io/tilokit/install.sh | bash

After installation, restart your terminal or run source ~/.bashrc to use the tilokit command.

💾 Platform-Specific Downloads

Choose your platform for direct binary download. All binaries are statically compiled and require no dependencies:

🐧

Linux

Download TiLoKit for Linux systems. Compatible with Ubuntu, Debian, CentOS, Fedora, and other Linux distributions.

Download x86-64 Download ARM64

Installation Commands:

wget https://tienld-0801.github.io/tilokit/tilokit-linux-amd64
chmod +x tilokit-linux-amd64 && sudo mv tilokit-linux-amd64 /usr/local/bin/tilokit
🍎

macOS

Download TiLoKit for macOS. Supports both Intel and Apple Silicon (M1/M2) Macs with native performance.

Download Intel Download Apple Silicon

Installation Commands:

curl -LO https://tienld-0801.github.io/tilokit/tilokit-darwin-arm64
chmod +x tilokit-darwin-arm64 && sudo mv tilokit-darwin-arm64 /usr/local/bin/tilokit
🪟

Windows

Download TiLoKit for Windows. Compatible with Windows 10/11 and supports both x86-64 and ARM64 architectures.

Download x86-64 Download ARM64

Installation Commands:

curl -LO https://tienld-0801.github.io/tilokit/tilokit-windows-amd64.exe

About TiLoKit

TiLoKit is a universal CLI toolkit designed to streamline multi-framework project generation. Whether you're building web applications with React, Vue, or Angular, backend services with Django, Flask, or Spring Boot, or mobile apps with React Native or Flutter, TiLoKit provides a single, unified interface to generate production-ready project templates.

Supported Technologies

Frontend: React, Vue.js, Angular, Svelte, Next.js, Nuxt.js, SvelteKit

Backend: Django, Flask, FastAPI, Express.js, NestJS, Spring Boot, Laravel, Rails, Symfony, CakePHP, CodeIgniter

Mobile: React Native, Flutter, Ionic

Desktop: Electron, Tauri

Languages: TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, Java, Go, PHP, Ruby, Rust, C#
